Since 2019Our story

One floor became three.

Cherry Drops opened in Khilgaon in 2019 with a line on the wall: Impossible happens. Uttara followed in 2023. Rampura opened in January 2026 and passed 1,500 members before its first birthday. The floors got bigger. The line on the wall stayed the same.

The houseFacilities

Built to be used hard.

The floor comes first. Everything around it is there so you come back tomorrow.

  • Strength floor

    Racks, benches and a dumbbell wall that runs the length of the room.

  • Free weights

    International-standard iron, racked in order and ready.

  • Kickboxing zone

    Heavy bags and a striking corner, for the days you need to hit something.

  • Steam bathSaunaIce bathMassage chair

    Recovery

    Steam bath, sauna, ice bath and a massage chair, for after the last rep.

  • Cherry Drops Cafe

    Clean plates and cold drinks, a few steps from the floor.

  • Lounge

    Somewhere to sit before you start and after you finish.

Facilities differ by branch. Ask yours before you visit.

  • Male and female trainers
  • Workout plans
  • Diet plans for fat loss and weight gain
  • Free lockers
  • Supplement counter
Who trains hereTraining

Pick your corner.

Four kinds of people fill these floors every day. Find yours and see what Cherry Drops has ready for you.

Your student ID is your discount.

Pay for three months and train for four. Bring a valid student ID to the desk at any of the three branches.

  • 3 months + 1 free for ৳5,500
  • Valid student ID shown at the desk
  • Khilgaon, Uttara or Rampura
Ask about the Student package

Ladies Hour is yours.

A dedicated women's session with female trainers on the floor. It has its own programme, its own regulars and its own awards night.

  • Female trainers on the floor
  • Stick workouts, medicine-ball circuits and floor classes
  • A Ladies Hour party and award night
Ask about Ladies Hour

Train hard. Recover properly.

Come in after office, put in the work, then finish in the steam room, the sauna or the ice bath. Lockers are free, so your day bag stays out of the way.

  • 6 months + 1 free for ৳8,500 on the Warrior package
  • Steam bath, sauna and ice bath
  • Free lockers and a massage chair
Ask about the Warrior package

Serious iron, serious company.

A full free-weight floor, international-standard machines and a kickboxing zone with heavy bags. Members here compete in powerlifting, and the trainers will tell you when your form slips.

  • Racks, benches and a full dumbbell wall
  • Kickboxing zone with heavy bags
  • Trainers who watch and correct your form
